dex.entry: The charged husk of the Hollowfen Stillworks — a derelict Hollowing null-works set-piece in Coldfog Marches. Once a thunderhead-kin captured and drained into a null-lantern to power the Stillworks machinery, Nullhusk has become something new: a storm-shaped void that still generates electricity thro

art.silhouette: A thunderhead-bull silhouette rendered in absolute void: the body outline is a deep storm-shape filled with dark non-light, negative-space body, but from it leak erratic arcs of dead-current in a sickly violet-grey that never quite reaches the warmth of true storm-blue. The eyes are empty null-lantern apertures — circular, glass-cold, unlit. The horns still crackle with charge. Reads as something that was majestic and is now entirely hollow.

art.direction: The most haunting optional encounter in the game: a thunderstorm that has been hollowed out. Players will feel Còr's philosophy as something terrible and real through this one battle.
